figurative_meaning_en: A person with an extremely angry and stubborn nature
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বনগরুর মতো রাগ করে উঠল যখন তার কথা শোনা হল না।
এই গোঁয়ার লোকটি বনগরুর প্রকৃতির, কোনো কথাই মানে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He got as angry as a wild buffalo when his words were ignored.
This stubborn man has the nature of a wild buffalo and doesn't listen to anyone.
note: Refers to the wild and aggressive temperament of forest buffaloes in Bengali rural folklore.
